name: Inbox zero
oneLiner: a glass inbox card full of unread mail; the rows swipe away one by one, faster each time, each revealing a green archive backing, the count ticks down to zero and a green check empty state springs into the cleared list
say: when the speaker says their inbox handles itself or got cleared ('it triaged every email', 'I hit inbox zero by nine'): the rows archive under the setup and the empty state lands on 'zero' or 'done'. Set senders, subjects and the empty-state lines
